pages.title: East Java Destinations
pages.browserTitle: East Java Destinations | Bromo, Ijen & More | JVTO
pages.description: Explore breathtaking destinations in East Java with JVTO: Kawah Ijen, Mount Bromo, Tumpak Sewu, Madakaripura, and Papuma Beach — each reached by dedicated private vehicle with BBKSDA park clearance in hand.
pages.summary: The five East Java sites on JVTO's private circuit — volcano craters, canyon waterfalls, and a coastal headland.

pages.title: Mount Ijen Blue Fire Tour Guide — Permits, Health, Hike | JVTO
pages.description: Private Ijen blue fire hike from Surabaya or Bali. Gas mask, BBKSDA permit & health certificate coordinated. Tourist Police-led. 4.8★ Trustpilot.
pages.summary: Kawah Ijen — the world's highest-volume acidic crater lake, a pre-dawn blue-fire phenomenon, and a working sulfur-miner trail in Banyuwangi, East Java.

pages.title: Madakaripura Waterfall — Tour, Canyon Hike, Tips | JVTO
pages.description: Private Madakaripura waterfall tour from Surabaya — canyon hike, river crossing, all-inclusive crew. No shared groups. Tourist Police-led. 4.8★ Trustpilot.
pages.summary: Madakaripura — Java's tallest waterfall, reached through a narrow canyon gorge in Probolinggo, and held in tradition to be Gajah Mada's final retreat.

pages.title: Mount Bromo Sunrise Guide — Tours, Tickets & Tips | JVTO
pages.description: Private Mount Bromo sunrise tour from Surabaya or Bali. Dedicated 4WD jeep, guide & driver, all entrance tickets. Tourist Police-led. 4.8★ Trustpilot.
pages.summary: Mount Bromo — the smoking crater and Penanjakan sunrise inside the Tengger caldera, Probolinggo, East Java, reached by private 4WD jeep.

pages.title: Papuma Beach Jember — Coastal Tour, Rock Formations | JVTO
pages.description: Papuma Beach Jember — dramatic rock formations and white sand coastline. Add-on to Bromo or Ijen private tours from Surabaya or Bali.
pages.summary: Papuma Beach — white sand, offshore rock formations, and a cape headland in Jember; the only coastal stop on a JVTO East Java circuit.

pages.title: Tumpak Sewu Waterfall — Tour, Trail & Tips | JVTO
pages.description: Private Tumpak Sewu waterfall tour — jungle trail, canyon descent, all-inclusive. Combinable with Bromo & Ijen. Tourist Police-led. 4.8★ Trustpilot.
pages.summary: Tumpak Sewu — a multi-tiered curtain waterfall known as Java's Niagara, seen from the rim or from its misted base, in Lumajang, East Java.
